products.name: Game Fence
products.short: Heavy-duty knotted fence for wildlife ranches, conservancies and large farms.
products.description: Knotted high-tensile game fence designed to contain large wildlife including kudu, eland and buffalo. Heights 1.2–2.4 m. Built for Matabeleland and Mashonaland ranch conditions.

products.name: Barbed Wire
products.short: High-tensile 2.5 mm barbed wire for farm boundaries and perimeter topping.
products.description: 12.5 gauge galvanized barbed wire, barb spacing 75–100 mm, 100 m and 200 m rolls. Used as a standalone farm fence or as a top strand on diamond mesh.

products.name: Razor Wire
products.short: Concertina BTO-22 razor coils for high-risk commercial and institutional sites.
products.description: Maximum-security concertina razor wire in 450, 600 and 900 mm coil diameters. Hot-dip galvanized BTO-22 blades for prisons, mines, warehouses and wall-top upgrades.

products.name: Clear View Fence
products.short: Anti-climb welded mesh with unobstructed visibility for estates, schools and embassies.
products.description: 4.0 mm welded mesh, 76.2 × 12.7 mm aperture, anti-climb and anti-cut. Optional spike-top. Powder-coated forest green or galvanized finish.

products.name: Palisade Fencing
products.short: Steel palisade pales for industrial yards, schools and high-security compounds.
products.description: Locally fabricated W-section or D-section pales, powder-coated dark green or galvanized. A strong visual and physical deterrent.

products.name: Welded Mesh
products.short: Rigid welded panels for enclosures, reinforcement and industrial fencing.
products.description: Square and rectangular welded mesh in multiple gauges. Used for cages, machine guards, slab reinforcement and light security fencing.

products.name: Chicken Mesh
products.short: Lightweight hexagonal netting for poultry runs, gardens and small animals.
products.description: 0.7–1.0 mm hex netting, 25 mm and 50 mm apertures, heights 0.6–1.8 m. Galvanized against rust in the rainy season.

products.name: Field Fence
products.short: Woven field fence for cattle, goats and crop protection on rural properties.
products.description: Graduated mesh field fence that keeps livestock in and predators out. Ideal for mixed farming operations.

products.name: Electric Fence
products.short: Wall-top or full-height electric fence systems with energizer and siren.
products.description: High-voltage pulsed deterrent for residential and commercial walls. Kits include energizer, insulators, HT wire and battery backup options.

products.name: Gates
products.short: Custom sliding, swing and pedestrian gates fabricated to opening width.
products.description: Hot-dip galvanized steel gates: sliding, double-leaf and pedestrian. Mesh, palisade or clear-view infill. Automation on request.

products.name: Fence Posts & Standards
products.short: Galvanized line posts, corner posts, Y-posts and straining assemblies.
products.description: Round tube, Y-post and corner assemblies from 1.2 m to 2.4 m. Sold with stay wires and fittings.

rules.quote: Quotations are valid for 14 days from the date of issue. Prices are in USD and include materials; installation and transport are quoted separately unless stated. A 50% deposit secures materials, balance due on completion or before dispatch for supply-only orders.
rules.invoice: Payment is due within 14 days of invoice date unless otherwise agreed. A 15% VAT is applied to all taxable supplies. Late payments may attract interest at 5% per month. Goods remain the property of Barrier Builders until paid in full.
